summary: Retest of the iteration_14 fixes: all pass. Backend: 34/34 pytest cases pass (12 new in test_sales_source_module.py plus the 22 existing stats tests, including by_type, which failed last time). POST /api/sales now stores source_module and cricut_project_id. A 3D sale with no printer returns 400 'Seleziona una stampante'. An invalid printer id returns 400. A 3D sale with no filaments returns 400. Cricut and manuale sales save with printer_id='' and no filaments. For a Cricut sale with a project, the project's total_cost x quantity is added to the cost, so net_profit is correct; checked with quantity 2. An invalid cricut_project_id is ignored, with no 500. The 3D regression passes: costs match the formula and filament stock goes down. Analytics by_type returns all 3 groups. The timeline fills empty days (one point per day) and empty months (12 for a full year). A sale stored as '2011-05-06T10:00' on the end date is included. Dashboard total_hours now divides by batch_total (a quantity-3 sale with 6h added 6h). UI: the /print3d/calculator 3D sale shows the toast 'Vendita registrata!' and stock drops by 100g. The Cricut calculator 'calc-save-sale' shows 'Vendita Cricut registrata!' and the project is auto-saved. Both sales appear on /sales. The /statistics 'Vendite per tipo' donut shows Plotter / Cricut 82.1% and Stampa 3D 17.9%. No page errors.

minor.issue: The serializer (server.py ~1718-1742) leaves out source_module and cricut_project_id. They are stored, but the Vendite list and the copy-sale flow cannot see the type.

minor.endpoint: POST /api/sales (from the 3D Calculator with Cricut projects or equipment selected)
minor.issue: CalculatorPage adds the selected Cricut projects (extra_costs) and equipment to the quote, but createSale sends source_module='3d' plus only cricut_project_id. The backend adds the Cricut cost only when source_module=='cricut', and never adds equipment cost. The saved sale's total_cost therefore leaves these costs out, so net_profit is too high. This bug existed before these fixes.
ObjectId(f_usage.filament_id), ObjectId(acc_usage.accessory_id) and ObjectId(sale_id) are not checked first. A malformed id returns 500 instead of 400. Found by reading the code.
The project's total_cost includes marketplace, payment and VAT fees worked out on the project's recommended_price. If the sale_price differs, those fees are not recalculated. Low impact.

action_items: Add source_module and cricut_project_id to the GET /api/sales response
Pass the Cricut and equipment extra costs from the 3D Calculator into the sale's total_cost: either send extra_costs or cricut_project_ids and add them in create_sale
Check filament, accessory and sale ids with ObjectId.is_valid so a malformed id returns 400 instead of 500
critical_code_review_comments: create_sale's printer and filament checks are now correct and covered by tests
An unknown source_module value is treated as 3d (printer required) and stored as '3d'. This is consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (3D sale, Cricut sale, Vendite list, by_type donut)
